title: TECH!
description: a tech and magic based modpack.
body:
TECH! is an expansive NeoForge 1.21.1 modpack crafted for players who want the ultimate fusion of advanced industry, deep progression systems, immersive exploration, and a spark of magic. Built around a powerful technological backbone, it delivers a layered experience where automation, engineering, energy production, storage networks, and complex machinery all interconnect into one massive ecosystem of innovation.

At its core, the pack emphasizes large-scale factory building and intelligent automation. You’ll design intricate production lines, manage advanced power systems, and construct highly optimized processing chains using a wide array of industrial and engineering mods. Logistics, storage networks, and machine customization allow you to scale from simple workshops to continent-spanning megabases that run like perfectly tuned engines.

Exploration and worldbuilding are just as important as machinery. Enhanced biomes, structures, relics, artifacts, and progression systems reward curiosity and discovery, while advanced mapping tools ensure you always know where your next expansion site lies. Decorative and building mods provide massive creative freedom, letting you shape your bases into anything from futuristic laboratories to arcane industrial citadels.

Magic exists as a complementary force rather than the main focus. Arcane systems enhance technology, grant powerful abilities, and unlock unique mechanics that blend seamlessly with machines and automation. Equipment upgrades, trinkets, spell systems, and relics add depth to character progression without ever overshadowing the technological theme.

Quality-of-life improvements, performance optimizations, visual upgrades, and interface enhancements ensure the experience feels smooth, polished, and modern even with its enormous content scope. Whether you’re an engineer, explorer, builder, or strategist, TECH! delivers a rich sandbox where every system connects, every discovery matters, and every invention pushes you one step closer to mastering a world powered by both science and wonder.

This modpack is mostly for creative but possible, and very hard in survival. 

if you create a world it may freeze for a few seconds but don't worry, it will work after a few seconds. Also opening your inventory or almost any gui for the first time so Curios API Gui or your inventory will lag for a few seconds but after that it will be fine. 

Have fun playing!
